mapY(float val, float vmin, float vmax, float yBot, float yTop) =>
    float rng = math.max(vmax - vmin, syminfo.mintick)
    yBot + (nz(val, vmin) - vmin) / rng * (yTop - yBot)

visibleRange(int leftTime, int rightTime) =>
    float vh = high
    float vl = low
    bool started = false
    int i = 0
    while i < 5000 and not na(time[i])
        int t = time[i]
        if t >= leftTime and t <= rightTime
            if not started
                vh := high[i]
                vl := low[i]
                started := true
            else
                vh := math.max(vh, high[i])
                vl := math.min(vl, low[i])
        if t < leftTime
            break
        i += 1
    [vh, vl]

sparkPoints(series float srcVal, int len, int x0, int xStep, float yBot, float yTop, float vmin, float vmax) =>
    array<chart.point> pts = array.new<chart.point>()
    for i = 0 to len - 1
        float y = mapY(srcVal[len - 1 - i], vmin, vmax, yBot, yTop)
        array.push(pts, chart.point.from_index(x0 + i * xStep, y))
    pts

hudGeometry(int slot, int slotCount, float visTop, float visBot) =>
    float visSpan = math.max(visTop - visBot, syminfo.mintick)
    float gapY = visSpan * 0.04
    int n = math.max(slotCount, 1)
    float usable = visSpan - gapY * (n + 1)
    float h = usable / n
    float yTop = visTop - gapY - slot * (h + gapY)
    float yBot = yTop - h
    [yTop, yBot]

clearHud(array<box> boxes, array<polyline> polylines, array<label> labels) =>
    if array.size(boxes) > 0
        for i = 0 to array.size(boxes) - 1
            box.delete(array.get(boxes, i))
        array.clear(boxes)
    if array.size(polylines) > 0
        for i = 0 to array.size(polylines) - 1
            polyline.delete(array.get(polylines, i))
        array.clear(polylines)
    if array.size(labels) > 0
        for i = 0 to array.size(labels) - 1
            label.delete(array.get(labels, i))
        array.clear(labels)

addPivot(array<label> lbls, label lbl, int limit) =>
    array.push(lbls, lbl)
    if array.size(lbls) > limit
        label.delete(array.shift(lbls))

        cell(mobileTable, 1, 6, str.tostring(math.round_to_mintick(sma50)), maColor(sma50))
        headerCell(mobileTable, 0, 7, 'EMA' + str.tostring(ema1))
        cell(mobileTable, 1, 7, str.tostring(math.round_to_mintick(ema50)), maColor(ema50))
        headerCell(mobileTable, 0, 8, 'ADX')
        cell(mobileTable, 1, 8, str.tostring(math.round_to_mintick(adx)), adxBgSeri)
        headerCell(mobileTable, 0, 9, 'MACD')
        cell(mobileTable, 1, 9, str.tostring(math.round(macdLine, 4)), macdLine >= signalLine ? theme.bull : theme.bear)
        headerCell(mobileTable, 0, 10, 'Stoch')
        cell(mobileTable, 1, 10, str.tostring(math.round_to_mintick(stochK)), stochK > 80 ? theme.bear : stochK < 20 ? theme.bull : theme.tableBg)
        headerCell(mobileTable, 0, 11, 'CCI')
        cell(mobileTable, 1, 11, str.tostring(math.round_to_mintick(cci)), theme.tableBg)
        headerCell(mobileTable, 0, 12, 'MFI')
        cell(mobileTable, 1, 12, str.tostring(math.round_to_mintick(mfi)), theme.tableBg)
        headerCell(mobileTable, 0, 13, '%R')
        cell(mobileTable, 1, 13, str.tostring(math.round_to_mintick(wpr)), theme.tableBg)
        headerCell(mobileTable, 0, 14, 'VWAP')
        cell(mobileTable, 1, 14, str.tostring(math.round_to_mintick(vwapVal)), close >= vwapVal ? theme.bull : theme.bear)
        headerCell(mobileTable, 0, 15, 'ST')
        cell(mobileTable, 1, 15, stText, stDir < 0 ? theme.bull : theme.bear)
        headerCell(mobileTable, 0, 16, 'RelVol')
        cell(mobileTable, 1, 16, str.tostring(math.round(relVol, 2)) + 'x', volBgSeri)
        headerCell(mobileTable, 0, 17, 'HVN')
        cell(mobileTable, 1, 17, str.tostring(math.round_to_mintick(hvnPrice)), theme.tableBg)
        headerCell(mobileTable, 0, 18, 'Chop')
        cell(mobileTable, 1, 18, str.tostring(math.round_to_mintick(chop)), theme.tableBg)
        headerCell(mobileTable, 0, 19, 'OBV')
        cell(mobileTable, 1, 19, str.tostring(obv, format.volume), theme.tableBg)
        headerCell(mobileTable, 0, 20, g6)
        cell(mobileTable, 1, 20, tVol, volBgSeri)
        headerCell(mobileTable, 0, 21, 'MOM')
        cell(mobileTable, 1, 21, str.tostring(math.round_to_mintick(mom)), mom >= 0 ? theme.bull : theme.bear)

alertcondition(rsi >= 70, title = 'RSI >= 70', message = 'RSI overbought')
alertcondition(rsi <= 30, title = 'RSI <= 30', message = 'RSI oversold')
alertcondition(ta.crossover(macdLine, signalLine), title = 'MACD cross up', message = 'MACD bullish cross')
alertcondition(ta.crossunder(macdLine, signalLine), title = 'MACD cross down', message = 'MACD bearish cross')
alertcondition(ta.crossover(close, emaRegime), title = 'Close x EMA200 up', message = 'Price crossed above EMA200')
alertcondition(ta.crossunder(close, emaRegime), title = 'Close x EMA200 down', message = 'Price crossed below EMA200')
